bundle packages | always | Packages from the official & CachyOS repos
bundle aur | always | AUR packages (rebuilt with paru)
bundle app-chatterbox | always | chatterbox (app + autostart)
bundle app-htop | always | htop (app + settings)
bundle app-kitty | always | kitty (app + settings)
bundle app-obs-studio | always | obs-studio (app + settings)
bundle app-openrgb | never | OpenRGB (app + settings)
bundle brave | always | Brave (auto-grouped)
bundle cfg-openssh | always | openssh settings + service
bundle example | always | Example (auto-grouped)
bundle games | always | Games (auto-grouped)
bundle limine | always | Limine (auto-grouped)
bundle openlinkhub | hw:usb:2345:0001 | Openlinkhub (auto-grouped)
bundle rclone | always | Rclone (auto-grouped)
bundle services | always | Enabled system services
bundle user-services | always | Enabled user services
bundle configs | always | Tweaked package settings
bundle other-files | always | Other hand-installed system files
bundle firmware-acmebt | hw:usb:1234:0b01 | Firmware acmebt for Example Bluetooth Adapter
bundle firmware-acmewifi | hw:pci:1234:5678 | Firmware acmewifi for Example Wireless 9000
bundle firmware-other | samehost | Firmware other
bundle kparam-nvidia-drm | hw:module:nvidia_drm | Kernel params for the nvidia-drm driver
bundle kparam-vfio-pci.ids | hw:pci:1234:abcd,pci:1234:abce | Kernel param vfio-pci.ids=1234:ABCD,1234:abce (hides Example Graphics 500)
bundle snapshots | rootfs:btrfs | Btrfs snapshots (snapper)
bundle boot | samehost | Initramfs & kernel module settings
bundle kparams | always | Kernel parameters
bundle locale | always | Locale, keyboard & timezone
bundle xkb | always | Keyboard tweaks (/etc/xkb): custom
bundle account | always | Group memberships & login shell
bundle login | samehost | Login screen & automatic login
bundle fingerprint | hw:usb:1234:0042 | Fingerprint login: reader driver, fingerprint for sudo/polkit, enrolled prints
bundle dev-tools | always | Language tools (cargo, pipx, npm, flatpak)
bundle network | always | Wi-Fi & VPN connections (with passwords)
bundle bluetooth | hw:bt:00:11:22:aa:bb:cc | Bluetooth pairings
bundle identity | samehost | Machine identity: hostname desktop, SSH host keys, Tailscale node
bundle root-home | samehost | root's home directory
bundle srv | samehost | /srv
bundle other-paths | samehost | Other backed-up system paths
bundle home-keys | always | Home: SSH & GPG keys
bundle home-files | always | Home: documents and photos
bundle home-apps | always | Home: app settings & data (dotfiles)
bundle home-display | samehost | Home: monitor layout
bundle disk-layout | samehost | Disk layout & bootloader config (shown as a diff, never copied)
